**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "A malty, full-bodied black tea that stands up to milk" | Product/flavour fact, fine as written |
| "boosts your immunity through winter" | **Unsupported.** Not on the allowlist and no source supplied. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted |
| "100g tin, makes around 40 cups" | Product fact (size, brewing), fine |

**The problem**

"Boosts your immunity through winter" is a health claim. Tea can't carry it under UK nutrition and health claims rules unless it's an authorised claim, and nothing here backs it up. It's also a hard claim ("boosts") with no source. It needs to go, not be softened to "can help", because softening would still be an unsupported health claim.

**Compliant version**

> Assam Breakfast. A malty, full-bodied black tea that stands up to milk. Certified organic by the Soil Association. 100g tin, makes around 40 cups.

If you want a winter angle, a non-health one works: "A warming cup for dark mornings" makes no factual claim, so it's safe.

**Other checks**
- No ban-list words, no invented stats, no fake urgency, no superlatives.
- No disclosure issues (no affiliate or sponsored content on this page).
